page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at the top, printed page number at top left, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Quæ est diuisio ex caussa Efficiente? Quæ genus in species ex causarum efficientium varietate diuidit.veluti, Arborum alię spóte na-scuntur (ait Plinius) alię ex semine, alię ex tra-ducę. Animalium aliud ex parente, aliud à sole, aliud ex putredine nascitur.

Quæ est ex Materia? Quæ genus in species pro cuiusq; materię varietate distribuit: veluti, Metallorum aliud est aurum, aliud argentum, aliud æs, aliud ferrum. Prædium aliud est urbanum, aliud rusticum.nam urbanum (in-quiunt Iurisconsulti) non locus facit, sed materia. Vasorum quædam sunt ærea, quædam vitrea, quædam fictilia.

Quæ est ex Forma? Quæ genus in species ex formarum varietate distribuit: veluti, navium aliæ sunt constratæ, aliæ aperte, aliæ turritæ, aliæ rostratæ, aliæ biremes, aliæ triremes, aliæ quadriremes. Linearum alia recta est, alia obliqua.

Cedo exemplum ex fine. Navium aliæ sunt actuariæ, aliæ piscatoriæ, aliæ onerariæ, aliæ speculatoriæ. Seruorum alij sunt atrienses, alij dispensatores, alij topiarij, alij amanuenses, alij scriptores. Vasorum alia sunt vinaria, quædam escaria, quædam aquaria, quedā vnguentaria.
Quæ est diuisio ex effectis? Quæ genus in species pro effectorum varietate dispertit. veluti herbarum quedā calefaciendi vim habent,
Stray mark at the bottom centre is not text and is left out.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "spóte" (accent as printed, uncertain); "diuidit.veluti" (no space after the full stop, copied as printed); "quedā" (tilde as printed, the word may be quædam); "vnguentaria" (printed v read as u by the rule, the word should be unguentaria but I kept the printed v in the rule-based spelling list, check); "cuiusq;" and "rusticum.nam" copied as printed. The catchword "quædam" stands at the lower right after the last line. The running head is printed without spacing as DIALECTICAE. No printing errors were corrected.
